class_guess: Bell eats counter: tm108-like 110/010 bell eats a 3-cell-digit binary counter; eat size varies (not BECv1)
summary: BECv1 tm108 twin (E1, F0 differ): 110/010 bell eats a binary counter; eat size varies, left language open
mechanism: Tape = L | bell `1 (110)^e (010)^f 1 0^inf`, e+f = N per epoch; each round e+1, f-1 and L (binary counter, 3-cell digits) gains 1/2.
At f = 0 the bell eats the low 3e'-2 cells of L: f' = N, e' = 1 (odd last round) or 2..47 (even); L then mixes digit kinds.
Exact so far: sweeps R1-R4 and INC2 on pure counters; open: carry/eat on mixed words. tm108 cert: 9/12 hold (HL2, HR2, HE2 fail).

rules.name: R1 A-sweep over 110 (as BECv1 HR1 shape)
R2 B-sweep back over 010 (= tm108 HR3)
R3 B-sweep back over 001 (uses F0, ours only)
INC2 pure counter, suffix 001 (two rounds)
rules.cases: W(v) = v in k blocks 000/001, MSB first, 0<=k<=7; v = 2^k-1 overflows to 1 (000)^(k+1) 001; e>=1, f>=0

rules.name: ROUND (blank run): bell e+1, f-1
rules.cases: every round from blank to step 100,000,000,000; L' = L with the counter's half-step (carry depth = turn offset)

rules.name: RESET-odd: epoch ends on a deep-turn round
rules.cases: all 480 odd resets from blank to step 100,000,000,000

rules.name: RESET-even: bell eats 3e'-2 cells of L
rules.cases: e' in 2..47, not yet predicted from L; all 602 even resets from blank to step 100,000,000,000 (boundary shift 2-3e' checked on all 1081/1081 resets)

template.module: BECv1 (Section in verify/BECv1.v); tm108 / nonhalt108, cert Build_BEC_cert_v1 B A E A ... 1 0 0
template.note: scripts/template_check.py runs tm108's 12 cert hypotheses on both machines: tm108 12/12 (sanity), ours 9/12 (25/25 each). Fail 0/25: HL2 (binary carry 1 <E -> <E 1, needs E1=1LE), HR2 (00 marker step, uses F0) and HE2 (marker birth). So the sweeps and the eat pieces HE0/HE1/HE3 carry over; the counter (3-cell digits), the marker (a 110|010 border, not 00) and the eat size (3e'-2 cells, e' = 1..47, not a = 1) do not.

risks: The eat size e' depends on the counter's digits at the reset (arithmetic feedback); if the reachable L words are not regular, a hand proof is hard.
Real left words with a too-small bell (N < |L|) do halt (2/300 replay starts), so the invariant needs a quantitative N vs |L| bound.
Sibling #29 (F0 = 0LB) looks similar but its trajectory differs (1e8: span -1917..265 vs ours -1929..263); a shared proof is not guaranteed.

checkpoint_questions.text: rounds_aligned: does each triangle read as one epoch (orange e grows, blue f shrinks), and does the left word get shorter at each new triangle, i.e. the bell eats the counter?
Close-up: around step 300,164 the bell's white region gives way and a new pattern starts further left. Does that match 'the bell eats the counter' to you?
Confidence is low: the left-word language and the eat size e' are open. Should we spend a deepen stage on them (carry/eat automaton + closure fuzz), or park this machine behind the others?

status_reason: Low confidence. ROUND/RESET structure holds on every round from blank to 100,000,000,000 steps (0 exceptions) and INC2 is exact on pure counters, but the left-word language and the eat size are not derived. Not a cryptid candidate yet: no halt depends on the eat sizes in the tests.
